fleet_requirement.note: Even at full inverter output the claim needs about 81 inverter homes; the legacy fleet has 13. The remaining energy has to come from deferred appliances and the community battery, which this legacy case does not have.

notes: The 56.25 kW / 42.19 kWh figure is not reproduced by the committed simulation. It is retained only as the legacy claim being audited.
battery_kwh is AC energy measured at the inverter output; deferred_kwh is appliance load moved out of the window. Rebound and recharge return later and are reported separately.
The best 45-minute window is an upper bound on what the modelled fleet can deliver, not an operating schedule.
